name: Hard Scandal ~In'yoku no Onna Kyoushi~
original_name: ハードスキャンダル～淫欲の女教師～
source:
I wanna fuck.

I can't take it anymore.

How many times have I jerked off thinking about Yamamoto-sensei?

A hundred times? Two hundred?

Since April, for over a month now, I’ve done it at least three times a day, every day without fail.

And lately, it’s been ramping up — five, six times a day.

…I can feel it.

I can’t hold back anymore.

I need Yamamoto-sensei.

I want to have her.

I want to make her mine.

Yamamoto, Ayaka-sensei…

Lately, I can’t think about anything but her.

Every day, no matter what I’m doing, she’s stuck in my head.

Everything about her makes me think of sex.

Just looking at her, all I can imagine is fucking her.

I keep wondering — is this some kind of sign?

A sign that I’m becoming an adult?

A sign that I can have her…

That’s why, starting today, I’m making my move.

I will make Yamamoto Ayaka mine, no matter what!

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041017014027fw_/http://www.r18game.com/haoh/jokyoushi/jokyoshi.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
好想做爱。

我已经快要憋疯了。

脑子里想着山本老师自慰，到底已经有过多少回了？

一百回？还是两百回？

打从四月起，这一个多月来，我每天至少都要来上三发，一天也没落下过。

到了最近更是变本加厉——一天就要来上五六回。

……我能清楚地感觉到。

我已经再也忍不下去了。

我想要山本老师。

想抱她。

想把她彻底据为己有。

山本老师……绫香老师……

近来，我的脑海里除了她之外再也装不下任何东西。

每一天，无论在做什么，她的身影都在我脑子里挥之不去。

她身上的一切，都勾得我满脑子淫念。

光是看着她的模样，我就忍不住幻想侵犯她的画面。

我不禁暗自思忖——这莫非是某种征兆？

预示着我已经长大成人的征兆？

预示着我可以将她占为己有的征兆……

所以，从今天起，我要付诸行动了。

无论使出什么手段，我都要把山本绫香变成我的女人！

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041017014027fw_/http://www.r18game.com/haoh/jokyoushi/jokyoshi.html]官方网站[/url]]
